title: Social Security Act
source_id: 42 U.S.C. 301 et seq. (ch. 7); short title at 42 U.S.C. 1305; Aug. 14, 1935, ch. 531, 49 Stat. 620
verified_how: Fetched govinfo USCODE-2024 42 U.S.C. 1305, headed 'Short title of chapter'. The text reads 'This chapter may be cited as the "Social Security Act"'. The notes include the Social Security Fairness Act of 2023.
notes: Title II provides Old-Age, Survivors, and Disability Insurance. Payroll contributions are levied by the Federal Insurance Contributions Act, which is chapter 21 of the Internal Revenue Code.
